body.statement: For a fixed positive optimization penalty \(\lambda_{\mathrm{FRX}}\) in the regular interior assignment problem of Fang, Ridder, and Xie, their Theorem 1 identifies the efficient influence function of the best-in-class assignment parameter as the inverse negative criterion Hessian times the derivative of the efficient penalized-welfare score and identifies its covariance as the semiparametric efficiency bound.

attestation.note: Verified against Theorem 1 in the version-3 arXiv HTML on 2026-09-14; the stable source handle is supplied in lieu of a long verbatim transcription.
